description: Call a business to ask for information on a named person’s behalf. Use when find_business_agent returned not_found; use send_to_business when a Direct card exists. Requires direct:tasks, human opt-in at https://odilelabs.com/developers#voice and permission for this call. Informational calls only, during weekday business hours; no sales, payments or account access. Reuse message_id on retries. Returns task_id, state and status; read get_call_result for progress and answers. Voice credit prices: get_m2m_network.

callback_number.description: That person’s own callback number in E.164.

caller_name.description: The named person who requested this call.

max_seconds.description: Maximum call duration, from 60 to 600 seconds, subject to available credits.

message_id.description: A stable request id; reuse it unchanged on every retry.

need.description: The information the person wants from the business.

on_behalf_consent.description: True only after that person asked for this call.

questions.description: Up to five questions to ask the business.

name: call_business
title: Call a business without a Direct card
